renderer_definitions.name: persona_lab
renderer_definitions.description: Standalone Persona Studio for editing ProPaasAI personas against the Cloudflare dev control plane and launching save-first single-run and parallel run batches.

registry_index.summary: Standalone Persona Studio for editing ProPaasAI personas through the Cloudflare dev control plane and launching native MCPViews single-run and parallel run test chats.

plugin_rules: Persona Studio is a standalone renderer that should target the ProPaasAI Cloudflare dev control plane at https://dev.app.tribexai.com through MCPViews first-party AI configuration, then launch save-first native AI single runs and parallel run batches in MCPViews.
